title: statutory-offences-of-causing-death-by-driving-sentencing-guideline.pdf — section 17
text:
30. The offender must be disqualified from driving for a minimum period of twelve months. When
a sentence of imprisonment or detention is imposed, the period of disqualification which the
court would otherwise have imposed must be extended by a period equal to half the sentence
of imprisonment or detention.4

4 Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 section 35C
Statutory offences of causing death by driving
Sentencing guideline
s2B Causing death by careless, or inconsiderate,
driving
Step 2: Select the sentencing range

28. The court should then use the following table to select the appropriate sentencing range.
This is the range of sentences within which the appropriate headline sentence for the offence
appears to fall, having regard to the assessment of seriousness at step 1.

LEVEL RANGE

SERIOUSNESS
A Level 2 community payback order – 2 years’
custody
B Level 2 community payback order
C Fine of up to £10,000 – level 2 community
payback order
